title: IPFS MCP resource URIs
description: URI forms served by ipfs mcp as MCP resources. ipfs:// and ipns:// map to /ipfs/ and /ipns/ content paths read through the connected daemon's RPC API (untrusted content, contentEgress). ui:// names MCP App views embedded in the binary; they never reference a network origin.

IpfsUri.description: ipfs://<cid>[/<path>], equivalent to the content path /ipfs/<cid>[/<path>]. No path segment may be . or .. (R13 security L2).

IpnsUri.description: ipns://<name>[/<path>], where name is a libp2p-key CID or a DNSLink domain; equivalent to /ipns/<name>[/<path>]. The name may not start with a dot, and no path segment may be . or .. (R13 security L2).

UiUri.description: ui://ipfs-mcp/<view>: an MCP App view served from content embedded in ipfs mcp.
